plan.notes: University of Denver is on the quarter system (Fall/Winter/Spring); term_system=quarter. Official sample four-year schedule from the 2025-2026 Undergraduate Bulletin Psychology program PDF (12 quarters). The bulletin provides ONE combined 'BA/BS in Psychology' sample schedule for the psychology major ('Here is a sample four-year schedule of courses for a psychology major'); it is encoded here as BA per the collector convention for combined plans (cf. university-of-denver-ba-computer-science); no degree-specific differences appear in the schedule itself. Plan states Total Credits: 190; declared total 190; term totals (Y1 16/16/16, Y2 14/16/16, Y3 16/16/16, Y4 16/16/16) reconcile exactly. Generic slots (language/SI sequences, AI/SI requirements, PSYC course groups, ASEM, minor/elective blocks, study-abroad block) encoded as choice slots exactly as the official plan lists them; no courses invented. The bulletin prints 'PSYC 2031, 2031, 2070, 2500, or 2740' in Second Year Winter with the duplicated 2031 — reproduced verbatim (probable bulletin typo), documented here. Footnote 1: INTZ 2501 is required for any student who studies abroad and may be taken in any quarter within the year prior to studying abroad. BA requires 40 credits of psychology (25 at 2000/3000 level) plus one minor or a second major; only PSYC-prefixed courses count toward the major, and at most 60 PSYC credits count toward BA totals.
